text:
Ava: Quick check-in 0h until go/no-go gate for marketplace launch. Need last confirmations on partner creative, press kit, and the SI demo flows.
Marcus: I'll own the livestream ops. Need final speaker list + temp contact for AV. Who's the SI rep?
Will: SI rep is Elaine from IntegrateCo. Elaine, can you confirm the demo script and two example customer orgs?
Elaine: Confirmed. Sending demo script v3 in 30m. We pared down to a 6min customer flow + 3min integration deep-dive.
Tess: Press embargo timeline: embargo lifts 09:00 PT. We must have landing up by 08:30 PT and media kit in Google Drive by 07:45 PT. Legal signoff cutoff 06:30 PT for partner quotes.
Priya: Nimbus legal said they'd push partner quote and the approved logo pack by 18:00 PT today. If that misses, we fallback to the monochrome logo provided earlier.
Will: Landing page checklist: hero image, partner logos (SVG), demo CTA, docs link, newsletter opt-in. Docs link points to /docs/marketplace/sis. PR is open: https://internal.docs/repo/pr/489. Need final YAML snippet from eng-ml for auth header example.
Ava: Also ensure marketplace pricing blurb is in the press kit  not the full pricing table, just starter bullets. Who owns that blurb?
Tess: Marketing will supply the blurb. I'll paste into the media kit draft after Nimbus quote lands.
Marcus: Livestream run of show: 00:00-00:30 intro/key metrics, 00:30-08:30 product demo, 08:30-12:30 partner remarks (Nimbus + SI), 12:30-22:30 live Q&A. Need an engineer on standby for model hot-swap during demo.
Priya: Noted re: Nimbus asset delivery. If they can't provide high-res hero, we can use demo screenshots and a co-branded banner.
Will: Dev blocker: demo region quota limited for reserved GPUs. @devops-bot what's the status on capacity reservation for Thursday demos?
devops-bot: Capacity request submitted at 1751234520  reserved pool approved for staging. Production quota increase pending with cloud provider. ETA 1751234580.
Marcus: Ok, we'll run staging demo with reserved pool if prod quota not green. Add a short note to the run of show explaining fallback visuals for streaming.
Ava: Final owners: Press = Tess, Landing + Docs = Will, Partner assets + legal touchpoint = Priya, Livestream = Marcus, SI coordination = Elaine. Rehearsal tomorrow 09:00 PT full run (please be on time).
Tess: I'll circulate the embargoed PR to legal at 05:45 PT for a 06:30 signoff window. If legal flags anything, we default to delaying partner quotes in the kit.
Elaine: Sending demo artifacts and test accounts to Marcus and Will after script v3.
Priya: Following up with Nimbus contact now and escalating to their PM if assets delayed past 18:00 PT.
Will: I'll merge the docs PR once eng-ml drops the YAML auth snippet. ETA?
Ava: Thanks team. Post here if any late blockers. If we get green by EOD, we'll do a final quick sync 20:00 PT for any edge issues. :rocket:
